description.value: Tea One is an authentic Taiwanese bubble tea shop in Maple Ridge's Haney neighbourhood, self-described as the only dedicated bubble tea spot in the area. The shop specialises in handcrafted drinks — fruit slushes, classic milk teas, and house-made tapioca pearls — using ingredients sourced directly from Taiwan. Online ordering for pickup is available through the website and a dedicated mobile app, making it a convenient refreshment stop on Lougheed Highway.
